summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its special meeting of stockholders held on June 9, 2026 lacked a quorum and was adjourned to June 15, 2026. The meeting was called to vote on proposals from a May 29 proxy statement. No substantive business was conducted; only a procedural adjournment to solicit additional proxies. There are no deal terms, strategic actions, or special-situation events. This filing is a routine notice of adjourned meeting and does not constitute a special situation.
